### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/experiments/material-facts-v7/immutable-artifact-publication.mjs#L23 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Remove the stage when immutable publication loses** When `assess.mjs` is rerun against an existing frozen `results/*/report.json`, or when a concurrent publisher loses the `link` race, this call throws `EEXIST` without removing the completed stage. Because the stage lives beside the report, it becomes an extra file inside the immutable attempt; `verifyExperiment()` later hashes every file under `results`, so the rejected publication makes the frozen result manifest fail until someone manually deletes the stage. Preserve stages for actual write/sync failures, but clean up the losing stage on an `EEXIST` publication collision. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/AGENTS.md#L9-L9) --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/experiments/material-facts-v7/run.mjs#L190-L191 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Quarantine malformed stdout before appending events** When the worker or one of its imported model-loading dependencies emits any newline-terminated non-JSON text on stdout, this append succeeds before `JSON.parse(line)` throws. The runner then records an output failure and stops, but the malformed line remains in `events.jsonl`; `verifyExperiment()` reparses that file with `jsonl()` and aborts before it can manifest the failed formal attempt. Since the `holdout--1` directory cannot be reused, preserve the offending bytes in a separate raw/partial artifact and append only validated event JSON to `events.jsonl`. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/AGENTS.md#L9-L9) --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/experiments/material-facts-v7/run.mjs#L281-L282 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Serialize holdout runs with final publication** When a formal Qwen run is still processing later materials, this branch bypasses the experiment lock even though the runner writes a valid prefix `outcome.json` after every completed material. If assessment, summary, and `verify.mjs --write-manifest` run during that interval, the verifier accepts the prefix as an incomplete run and can publish an immutable manifest; the next Qwen material then appends events/results and rewrites the outcome, immediately invalidating a manifest that cannot be republished. Put holdout execution and report/comparison/manifest publication under a shared lifecycle lock, or expose an active marker that finalization must reject. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/AGENTS.md#L9-L9) --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/experiments/material-facts-v7/run.mjs#L264 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Replace outcome checkpoints atomically** When a Qwen attempt is interrupted or encounters a filesystem failure while saving a later batch, this `writeFile` can truncate the existing valid `outcome.json` before the replacement is complete. Verification then cannot parse the receipt, while the formal attempt directory remains permanently allocated and cannot be reused, so otherwise preserved results cannot be finalized. Write each mutable checkpoint to a same-directory temporary file and atomically rename it over the previous checkpoint. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b199f52154d0eab731cb7d562ca02cff53021fe8/AGENTS.md#L9-L9)

Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍.
